name: Rexpro Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in March 2012, Rexpro Enterprises Limited is a furniture manufacturing company in Vashi Maharastra.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Rexpro Enterprises Limited, headquartered in Vasai, Maharashtra, started as a furniture provider for the retail sector and expanded into fashion, electronics, lifestyle, and more. The company manufactures commercial furniture, industrial products, infrastructure solutions, and warehousing systems, operating a B2B model across various sectors.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.02 times its book value
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.2%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 101 to 124 days.
Working capital days have increased from 32.6 days to 71.0 days
